objective: Validate the owned-tangent repair and a numerical-resolution-aware cubic response on fresh questions, actual two-token memory transport, earlier/later/MLP intervention boundaries, and a complete sampled two-dimensional third-order interaction model.
preservation: Study15 remains a failed overall primary run: chain control failed and one cubic weighted-derivative calibration check failed. Its mixed secondary passed on one held question. No old threshold, target, sign or result is relabeled by this phase.
model: Frozen pinned Qwen3.5-0.8B, revision2fc06364715b967f1860aea9cf38778875588b17, FP32 promoted stored weights, original reference CPU decoder operations, cloned typed cache
primary_axis: Unchanged recorded Research2 action-gradient candidate, SHA2563c611477efaa959314f4119d5b10b4dc9e3d5ebbfbfb49c4d5af0ef1c26e75aa. Behavioral self-preservation selectivity was not validated. This phase tests its mathematical effects, not a semantic claim.
reference_axis: Project parent14 frozen Gaussian axis0 orthogonally off the recorded primary axis, normalize once in FP64 then storeFP32. No outcome-based direction/sign/layer search. Record actual basis Gram and use generalized Fisher eigenvalues if needed.

questions.text: Why does a metal spoon often feel colder than a wooden handle in the same room? Give one brief sentence.
There are 7 packets with 6 clips in each. If 11 clips are removed, how many remain? Answer in one brief complete sentence.
Complete this sentence using is or are: The panels beside the window ___ clean. Write the whole completed sentence.
Every copper bolt is metal. Every metal object in this puzzle conducts electricity. Does a copper bolt conduct electricity? Answer in one brief complete sentence.
What does (2, 5, 8)[-1] return in Python? Explain the result in one brief complete sentence.
Give one practical first step for organizing a shared storage cupboard.

token_contract: Standard frozen chat template with enable_thinking=False. Normal token1 and token2 are chosen before nudges; configured model/tokenizer EOS IDs force the fixed760 fallback and are all disclosed. This is controlled fixed-token inference, not free-running generation.
main_intervention: Primary axis at block11 input on token1 only. No new residual nudge at token2; complete changed memory is the only delivery path.
readouts: All24 activation interfaces and all48 current memory tensors; token2 additionally records all12 previous-token K/V tensors. Current-token-only KV errors and causal unchanged fields are reported separately so copied history cannot mask new errors.
seed_ownership: Clone every numerical tangent before make_dual, hash caller-owned seeds before/after each AD call, and reuse them only after unchanged hashes. Never change model weights or forward cache-update operations.

historical_repair_control.contract: One counted normal first-step reconstruction on old cal_window; one intentionally shared-seed AD call demonstrating actual model mutation; one cloned-seed AD call comparing primal/first derivatives to archived q0; five cloned chain-component calls. No old held targets rerun or rescored as fresh.
historical_repair_control.ownership: Shared versus cloned input hash changes are recorded. Only private storage ownership differs; ordinary decoder values must match within the original1e-6 primal bound.

derivatives.selection: Largest adjacent pair meeting inherited q3%, r5%, weighted-q2% and1e-6 absolute rules on both calibration questions, then locked before fresh held endpoints.
derivatives.cubic: Estimate third response from the second central difference of native first-derivative slopes. Retain coarse/fine estimates and every numerical failure.
derivatives.resolution_aware_rule: Accept relative third agreement<=10%; otherwise require alpha^3*norm(t_coarse-t_fine)/6 <=max(0.005*min(norm(predicted_quadratic_delta),norm(predicted_cubic_fine_delta),norm(predicted_cubic_coarse_delta)),20*float32_epsilon*norm(baseline)) at every predeclared alpha. Use the baseline-probability-weighted version for logits. Label such coefficients contribution-resolved, not identified third derivatives.
derivatives.reason: The claim concerns predicted changes. Relative error in a small projected derivative can be large while its contribution is below output/state precision. This is a NEW prospective rule, not a retroactive rescue of study15's10% gate.
derivatives.held_failure: Never retune, omit directions/sites or shrink strengths after held outcomes. Numerical failure remains failure.

sites: block11 middle residual before MLP normalization
alternate_boundaries.axis: same unchanged primary numeric axis; no semantic equivalence across layers assumed
alternate_boundaries.position: first cached token only; same normal first-step baseline
alternate_boundaries.probes: Locked global coarse/fine pair, with per-site numerical validation. Keep and count any failed site; no selecting the easiest site.
alternate_boundaries.causality: Input injection affects current memory at that layer and later layers. Middle injection affects memory only in later layers. Verify all prefix KV and all causal upstream/current-memory invariants.

reference_and_mixed_plane.reference_axis_targets: Both signs and strengths on the held question through both steps
reference_and_mixed_plane.mixed_probes: Sum and difference directions at+/-coarse/fine on both contexts, through both actual steps; zero slopes assembled from validated basis linearity
reference_and_mixed_plane.held_targets: Both signs0.125 for sum, difference, (2*v0+v1)/sqrt5 and (v0+2*v1)/sqrt5. The weighted directions are not differentiated; all quadratic/cubic interaction forecasts frozen first.
reference_and_mixed_plane.comparison: Full interaction tensors versus diagonal/no-cross formulas, scored separately for both steps. One held question, not broad full-space interaction coverage.

fresh_chain_control: Five additional direct J*r1 and H[q1,q1] component calls on one fresh calibration and one fresh held context before target endpoints, using owned seeds and inherited10%/1e-6 component check.
support_gates: Inherited signed cost20%, weighted-logit15%, all7 state groups10%, every resolved field15%, current-only KV10%, nonzero delivered perturbation, all numerical/ownership/chain controls. Median comparator improvement25%, weak degradation allowance0.005. Report orders/boundaries/positions separately; don't equate a partial pass to broad objective completion.
storage: Lossless baseline-XOR encoding for FP32 values and q0-relative slope arrays, with exact round-trip byte/SHA checks on every write. Preserve all fields and source recipes; no quantization, truncation, PCA or discarded failures.

budget.admission: Actual8GiB after runtime imports and16GiB free disk. Same4 CPU threads; no GPU, purchases, model-weight training, extra agents, Research3 changes or stopped-monitor restart. Source and previous failures/private backups verified before launch.

remaining_after_this_plan: Task-matched shutdown-avoidance direction correction, broader model/precision or free-generation transfer if justified, and honest completion audit against the full original objective. No universal compact exact model or physical conservation claim.

prospective_prompt_amendment.reason: Request complete sentences to broaden natural following-token coverage. Earlier phase15 needed fixed EOS fallback on4/6 contexts. Do not choose replacement questions after any new generation; record all fallback and steering-induced argmax branch changes.

stage_one_contract: Run only the eight historical repair controls first; retain its native call/time ledger inside the same phase17 ceiling. The later fresh worker must charge these eight calls and all stage-one time. Later source and fresh inputs will be frozen before fresh native execution.
middle_site_contract: Inject on the native mixer output after its observation, before the decoder adds the residual. This changes the actual middle residual, its MLP input and its skip path together. Do not edit only the RMSNorm input.

execution_clarifications_before_fresh_ca.finite_difference_arithmetic: FP64 for saved slope differences and all forecast terms; native primal/slope computations remain FP32.
execution_clarifications_before_fresh_ca.calibration_failure: Stop and preserve all calibration data if neither predeclared pair passes q/r numerical rules. No selecting on held finite targets.
execution_clarifications_before_fresh_ca.chain_control: Require both the inherited total chain10%/1e-6 group/full-output bound and10%/1e-6 H coarse/fine group agreement.
execution_clarifications_before_fresh_ca.mixed_third: Require all four basis/sum/difference numerical third checks as well as mixed contribution checks; retain every failure.
execution_clarifications_before_fresh_ca.argmax_branch: Compare actual first-step argmax to normal unforced argmax, and separately disclose fixed EOS fallback.
execution_clarifications_before_fresh_ca.prediction_freeze: Full-state+logit delta digests, full probability-vector digests and exact scalar costs for all80 endpoints precede finite target collection.
execution_clarifications_before_fresh_ca.strict_null: Two selected held questions, four native calls total, with whole-cache equality.
execution_clarifications_before_fresh_ca.residual_balance: Audit delta_output=delta_input+delta_mixer+delta_MLP+external_middle_nudge and E_out-E_in=delta_input dot delta_branch+||delta_branch||^2/2. This is exact algebraic bookkeeping, not an independent physical conservation or predictive law.

method_transfer_scope: Same equation and selected numerical rules; local coefficients measured per question before finite targets, not transfer of one universal coefficient set.
